title: High-touch billing concierge: triage & decision matrix for commitment and marketplace requests
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem statement: Enterprise customers frequently submit nuanced billing requests (commitment sizing, proforma invoicing, marketplace offsets, and bespoke cost allocation) that don't fit automated intake rules. These requests require coordinated judgment across PM, Finance, Legal, and Solutions, but current routing is slow and inconsistent. This ticket defines a "billing concierge" triage and decision matrix to accelerate intake, standardize outcomes, and surface signals for automation.
acceptance_criteria: A1: A documented triage matrix exists mapping request archetypes to decision outcomes (auto-approve, concierge review, finance approval, legal review).
A2: Concierge lane SLA defined: initial acknowledgement within 24 business hours and target resolution timelines by archetype.
A3: A 5-factor scoring rubric implemented in intake form to prioritize queue ordering (ARR delta, contract complexity, legal touch, SLA risk, marketplace offset).
A4: Hand-off checklist and required artifacts (proforma, SOW, customer usage sample, marketplace SKU mapping) defined for Solutions/Finance.
A5: Pilot with 3 high-touch accounts run for 4 weeks and feedback captured; target median resolution time reduced by 40% vs baseline.
triage_scoring_rubric: Score components (0-5 each): ARR Impact, Contract Duration/Commitment Size, Technical Integration Complexity, Legal/Fraud Risk, Marketplace Offset Complexity.
Priority score = weighted_sum(ARR*0.4 + CommitmentSize*0.2 + TechComplexity*0.15 + LegalRisk*0.15 + Marketplace*0.1).
Thresholds: 8-10 = Concierge High (immediate human review), 5-7 = Concierge Normal (next-available reviewer), 0-4 = Automated/Backlog.

Example: 3-year $1.2M commitment with custom invoice terms -> ARR 5, CommitmentSize 5, Tech 2, Legal 4, Marketplace 1 => weighted = 5*0.4+5*0.2+2*0.15+4*0.15+1*0.1 = 3.75 + 1 + 0.3 + 0.6 + 0.1 = 5.75 => Concierge Normal.
playbook_steps: Intake: Customer submits billing request via enterprise intake form (GSA) or has CSM open a Concierge ticket. Required fields enforce artifact uploads (current invoice, requested terms, marketplace listing if applicable).
Auto-screen: Intake form calculates priority score and assigns to lane (Auto / Concierge Normal / Concierge High).
Concierge Triage (when assigned): Concierge PM reviews materials, normalizes request using archetype templates (Commitment Resize, Proforma Invoice, Marketplace Offset, Cost Reallocation).
Evidence collection: Concierge requests missing artifacts within 48 hours; if not provided, ticket downgraded to 'incomplete'.
Decision & Owner: For finance-impacting outcomes (credits, discounts, contract changes), Concierge prepares an approval packet and routes to Finance + Legal with recommended outcome and ETA.
Execution: Finance issues credits/invoices; Billing ops post-process and update customer. For marketplace offsets, Concierge works with Partnerships to create mapping and a backfill plan.
Close & Telemetry: Tag ticket with outcome, time to resolution, and reason code (policy, manual exception, product change request) for monthly trend analysis.
escalation_paths: If score >= 9 or customer is named enterprise strategic account -> immediate notify: Director of Revenue + Legal on creation (email + Slack).
If unresolved after 7 business days -> escalate to Head of PM and Finance lead for decision checkpoint.
If legal redlines detected -> pause execution and route to Legal counsel with 48-hour SLA for initial assessment.
